Excellent! All 51 tests pass, including the previously failing test. 

The issue was a floating-point precision problem: converting "39.95" euros to cents using the formula `Number(s).toFixed(2) * 100` produced 3995.0000000000005 instead of the integer 3995. The validation check required an integer value.

The fix was to use `Math.round()` directly in the conversion: `Math.round(Number(s.replace(/,/g, '')) * 100)` eliminates the intermediate rounding and ensures we always get a whole integer.

The fix was to use `Math.round()` directly in the conversion: `Math.round(Number(s.replace(/,/g, '')) * 100)` eliminates the intermediate rounding and ensures we always get a whole integer.
